name: @gamescore/sdk
description: Event-based browser game integration for GamesCore

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @gamescore/sdk-testing && npm run typecheck --workspace @gamescore/sdk-examples
scripts.dev: npm run build:all && npm run dev --workspace @gamescore/sdk-examples
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:all && npm run test:browser --workspace @gamescore/sdk-examples
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @gamescore/sdk-testing
